title: Page 3
content_zh:
就在大约十年前，隐族不愿帮某国做事，被下令追杀，原就不多的族人几乎只剩一半存活下来，幸赖前任兰王出兵相助，并且将兰凌国境内的云渺山赐给隐族人居住，承诺不会胁迫隐族人做任何事，隐族才终于有了安身之处。
身为族长的宗薰始终惦记这件事，在听到前任兰王因意外骤逝，只剩一位被病魔缠身的儿子继位，便决定用隐族代代相传的术数报恩。
「莹儿现在是王的『厄女』，也可以说是替王挡去灾厄病难的替身。」宗薰指指女儿的额头。「我在半年前王昏倒时已经施了『转厄咒』，她额心那一滴正是王的血印，也是转厄咒生效的证明，从那时开始，王的病气就转移到莹儿身上，由莹儿代王承受了。」
兰霆不敢相信这世上居然会有转移病厄的术数，但他康复和宗雪莹病弱的时间的确吻合，而他的母后也相信这件事，他不信也不行。
「为什么代本王受厄的人是她，不是别人？」他恼怒地质问，她年纪比他还小，他都快无法承受生病的痛苦，她只是一个小娃儿又怎么有办法忍受？她是何其无辜！
「我算遍族内所有人的生辰八字，莹儿和王的八字最配，最适合当王的厄女，莹儿也明白这么做是要报恩，并且同意了我的决定，所以王不必挂虑莹儿是被逼的。」她也很不忍心让女儿承受这种痛苦，但她算出女儿和王之间有很深的缘分，势必要在一起的，也就只能依天命行事。
第1章(2)
「她会有性命之危吗？」他的眉越皱越紧，如果她们事前告诉他这件事，他绝对不会答应，他宁愿自己病得死去活来，也不想让一个女娃儿代替他受罪。
「莹儿的身子骨天生就好，所以只要妥善地照顾，还是能够安然长大，这一点也请王不必担心。」
只要兰霆的病厄不至于危及性命，宗雪莹也不会有性命安危，等到哪一日兰霆的病厄之运过去，宗雪莹不必再承厄之后，状况也能好转。
宗薰算过，兰霆不是短命之人，所以她相信兰霆的病厄之运会有过去的时候，只不过无法预测是长是短，但一国之王长期处于重病当中，无法亲理朝政，对国家来说并不是件好事，甚至会引发动乱，所以她才会决定以这种方式报恩，让兰霆提早脱离病厄，能够正常的接掌国事，不再被病厄所扰。
「那如果她哪一日承受不了，或是出了什么意外，这咒是否就失效了？」
「的确，承厄者如果意外而亡，转厄咒失效，原本的病厄就会回到您身上，不过只要再找第二位能和王的八字相配合的承厄者，就可以再施转厄咒。」
她在帮王挑选最适合的承厄者时，就已经一并挑出第二、第三适合的人选，但她希望这只是备而不用，别真的走到这一步。
姜鸳紧接在宗薰话后说：「霆儿，雪莹替你承担病厄，咱们就得亲自负起照顾她的责任，小心保护，别让她出任何意外，直到你的病厄之运过去为止。」
如果没把宗雪莹留在王宫内，而让她回到云渺山去，姜鸳总觉得不放心，怕她会出意外而让事情再有变数，所以不管怎么想还是留在自己身边比较妥当，这在当初刚施完转厄咒时，姜鸳就已和宗薰讨论过，也已经得到宗薰的同意。
「母后，事已至此，儿臣难道还有拒绝的机会吗？」他还是气，气母后没先和他商量，就答应宗薰替他和宗雪莹施转厄咒，根本不管他的意愿。
「这……」姜鸳心虚得不再多话，她爱子心切，一心只想护住王室最后一根独苗，哪顾得了这么多？不过她相信，过一段时日，儿子就会释怀，会明白她为人母的心思，不再计较埋怨她的做法。
「另外，还要请王和太后别泄漏莹儿厄女的身分，以及她是隐族人的事情，咱们隐族因为这些术数在过往已经遭到太多野心人士觊觎，甚至面临杀身之祸，因此除非万不得已，并不轻易施咒，要是让其他人知道，恐怕会引起不必要的混乱，这点请二位体谅。」宗薰小心叮嘱，这次要不是为了报恩，她也不会轻易施咒的。
「本王明白。」兰霆看向躺在床上昏睡的小女娃，内心五味杂陈，既恼又怜，不知道该如何面对醒来后的她才好。

他想起两人半年前初见面时，她就知道自己是要来替他受罪的，为什么她还有办法笑得灿烂，一点都不怪他、怨他？
他想骂她笨、傻，但看着她苍白的脸色，他什么话都骂不出口，一颗心反倒微微揪痛着，对她泛起了更多的……怜惜。
她的傻气让他第一次有种想疼宠的冲动，还对她萌生了从来没有过的牵挂，不用母后刻意提醒，他也会好好照顾她，她替他承受的病痛，他会加倍补偿她，绝不让她受任何一丁点委屈。
只要他还活着，他就会让她也好好的活着，希望能继续看到她灿烂的笑容，别被病魔给摧残得不见了。
说什么报恩？他反倒觉得现在是他欠了她，这个情分还深得难以偿还……
兰霆在知道宗雪莹成为他的厄女之后，便时时派人关照着她，就算自己因为国事忙碌，不常亲自去看她，也会命令宫女每日将她的状况告诉他，而她在王宫里，不管吃穿用度都是最好的，俨然把她当成小公主般对待。
宫人们都知道兰霆对宗雪莹的重视，甚至连太后姜鸳也对她照顾有加，虽然不明白为什么，他们也同样小心地服侍她，把她当成贵客看待。
而兰霆对她的容忍，更是让其他宫人大感讶异，因为很讨厌被人缠着的他，居然允许宗雪莹三不五时便在他的身旁转，一点应有的礼节都没有。
「宗雪莹，你怎么又跑出来了？」
御书房里，兰霆瞪着窗户外正对着他灿笑的小丫头，真不知她为什么总能够从寝宫内偷溜出来透气，一而再、再而三，滑溜得像尾泥鳅，任宫女们怎么抓都抓不住？
她一个月前才因此而昏倒，他也因而知道了她代替自己承厄的事，没想到她完全没得到教训，依究乱来，气得他真想敲开她的脑袋，看里头到底都装些什么。
「王，我好累哦……」宗雪莹故意装傻，不回答他的话，反而摆出可怜兮兮的疲累模样，好博取同情。
「你……」他没辙地大翻白眼，没好气地命令太监。「快把她给带进来。」
「遵命。」太监赶紧走出御书房，将宗雪莹给请入书房里，还特别拿了一张铺了软垫的椅子让她坐，紧接着端上一杯茶，让她解渴，把她伺候得非常周到。
宗雪莹将杯中的茶一口气喝完，舒服地吐了一口气。「啊……真好喝，我以后要天天来找王喝茶。」
她笑笑地看着他，虽然他脾气不好，总是摆脸色凶她，但她却一点也不讨厌他，觉得他比总是谨慎行事的宫人们要真实好懂多了，从不会掩饰自己真正的一面，所以她很喜欢来找他抬杠，才不管他到底是不是王。
他很忙，虽然派人照顾她，却很少主动出现过，所以她干脆自己来找他了，就算只能见他半刻，她也会很开心的。
「你根本就是想天天来胡闹！」兰霆居高临下的瞪着小丫头，要是其他宫女太监们看到他的臭脸，早就战战兢兢了，就只有她完全不当一回事。「也不想想你现在身子的状况，禁得起多久折腾，早晚你会受不了的。」
content_en:
Just about ten years ago, the Yin tribe was unwilling to help a certain country and was ordered to be hunted down. Only half of the originally small tribe survived. Fortunately, the former King Lan sent troops to help, and gave the Yunmiao Mountain in Lanling Kingdom to the Yin tribe to live in, promising not to coerce the Yin tribe into doing anything. The Yin tribe finally found a place to stay.
As the clan leader, Zong Xun has always been thinking about this incident. After hearing that his predecessor, King Lan, died suddenly due to an accident, leaving only a son who was plagued by illness to succeed him, he decided to use the magic passed down from generation to generation by the Yin clan to repay his kindness.
"Ying'er is now the king's 'distressed daughter', which can also be said to be the substitute who protects the king from disasters and illnesses." Zong Xun pointed to his daughter's forehead. "I had already cast the 'Emergency Curse' when the king fainted half a year ago. The drop on her forehead was the king's blood mark, which is also proof that the curse has taken effect. From then on, the king's illness was transferred to Yinger, and Yinger bore it on the king's behalf."
Lan Ting couldn't believe that there was a way to avert illness in this world, but the time of his recovery coincided with Zong Xueying's illness, and his mother also believed in this matter, so he didn't believe it.
"Why is she the one who suffers on behalf of the king, and not someone else?" He asked angrily. She was younger than him, and he could hardly bear the pain of illness. How could she endure it when she was just a little kid? How innocent she is!
"I calculated the birthdays and horoscopes of everyone in the clan, and Yinger's horoscope matched the Wang's best, and was the most suitable to be the king's daughter. Yinger also understood that she wanted to repay the favor, and agreed with my decision, so the king did not have to worry about Yinger being forced." She also couldn't bear to let her daughter endure such pain, but she calculated that there was a deep fate between her daughter and the king, and they were bound to be together, so she could only act according to destiny.
Chapter 1(2)
"Is her life in danger?" He frowned more and more. If they told him this in advance, he would never agree. He would rather be sick and die than let a girl suffer on his behalf.
"Ying'er's body bones are naturally good, so as long as she is taken care of properly, she can still grow up safely. Please don't worry about this."
As long as Lan Ting's illness is not life-threatening, Zong Xueying's life will not be in danger. When Lan Ting's illness passes and Zong Xueying no longer has to endure the illness, her condition will improve.
Zong Xun has calculated that Lan Ting is not a short-lived person, so she believes that Lan Ting's bad luck will pass, but it is impossible to predict whether it will be long or short-term. However, the king of a country has been seriously ill for a long time and cannot personally manage the government. It is not a good thing for the country and may even cause turmoil. Therefore, she decided to repay her kindness in this way, so that Lan Ting could get rid of the illness early and be able to take over the affairs of the country normally and no longer be disturbed by the illness.
"Then if one day she can't bear it anymore or has an accident, will the spell be ineffective?"
"Indeed, if the bearer of misfortune dies unexpectedly and the curse of reversing misfortune becomes invalid, the original misfortune will return to you. However, as long as you find a second bearer of misfortune who can match the king's horoscope, you can cast the curse of reversing misfortune again."
When she helped Wang choose the most suitable person to bear the misfortune, she had already selected the second and third most suitable candidates, but she hoped that this was just a precaution and would not really come to this point.
Immediately after Zong Xun's words, Jiang Yuan said, "Ting'er, Xueying is responsible for your illness, so we have to personally take the responsibility of taking care of her and protect her carefully so as not to let any accidents happen to her until your illness has passed."
If Zong Xueying is not left in the palace and is allowed to return to Yunmiao Mountain, Jiang Yuan always feels uneasy, fearing that she will have an accident and cause things to change again, so no matter what, it is better to stay with him. Jiang Yuan had already discussed this with Zong Xun when he had just finished casting the evil spell, and had already received Zong Xun's consent.
"Mother, the matter has come to this, do you still have a chance to refuse?" He was still angry, angry that the mother did not firstAfter discussing with him, he agreed to Zong Xun to cast the curse on him and Zong Xueying, regardless of his wishes.
"This..." Jiang Yuan felt so guilty that she stopped talking. She loved her son so much and only wanted to protect the last single seedling of the royal family. How could she care so much? However, she believed that after a while, her son would let go, understand her thoughts as a mother, and stop complaining about her actions.
"In addition, I would also like to ask the king and the queen mother not to reveal the identity of Ying'er'er and that she is a member of the Yin tribe. Our Yin tribe has been coveted by too many ambitious people in the past because of these magic spells, and has even faced death. Therefore, unless it is absolutely necessary, we will not cast spells easily. If others know, it may cause unnecessary confusion. Please understand this." Zong Xun carefully warned that if it were not for repayment this time, she would not cast the spell easily.
"I understand." Lan Ting looked at the sleeping little girl lying on the bed. He felt mixed emotions in his heart, both annoyed and pitiful. He didn't know how to face her when she woke up.
He remembered that when the two first met half a year ago, she knew that she was going to suffer for him. Why could she still smile brightly without blaming or complaining about him at all?
He wanted to scold her for being stupid and stupid, but looking at her pale face, he couldn't say anything. Instead, his heart ached slightly, and he felt more... pity for her.
Her stupidity made him have the urge to pamper her for the first time, and he also cared about her like never before. He would take good care of her without his mother deliberately reminding her, and he would compensate her twice as much for the pain she endured for him, and would never let her suffer any grievance.
As long as he is still alive, he will let her live well, hoping to continue to see her bright smile and not be destroyed by the disease.
What do you mean by repaying a favor? On the contrary, he felt that he owed her now, and this debt was too deep to be repaid...
After Lan Ting knew that Zong Xueying had become his troubled daughter, he sent people to take care of her all the time. Even if he was busy with state affairs and did not often visit her in person, he would order the palace maid to tell him about her condition every day. In the palace, she was given the best food and clothing, and she was treated like a little princess.
Everyone in the palace knew how much Lan Ting valued Zong Xueying, and even Queen Mother Jiang Yuan took great care of her. Although they didn't understand why, they also served her with the same care and treated her as a distinguished guest.
Lan Ting's tolerance of her surprised the other palace people even more. Because he hated being pestered by others, he actually allowed Zong Xueying to hang around him from time to time without any proper etiquette.
"Zong Xueying, why did you run out again?"
In the imperial study room, Lan Ting stared at the little girl who was smiling brightly at him outside the window. He really didn't know why she could always sneak out of the palace to get some air. Over and over again, she was as slippery as a loach, and no matter how hard the palace maids tried to catch her, she couldn't catch her?
She fainted just a month ago because of this, and he also found out about her taking on the misfortune on his behalf. Unexpectedly, she didn't learn the lesson at all, and acted recklessly. He was so angry that he really wanted to crack her head open to see what was inside.
"Wang, I'm so tired..." Zong Xueying deliberately pretended to be stupid and didn't answer his words. Instead, she pretended to be pitifully tired to win sympathy.
"You..." He rolled his eyes in confusion and ordered the eunuch angrily. "Bring her in quickly."
"As ordered." The eunuch quickly walked out of the imperial study and invited Zong Xueying into the study. He also brought a cushioned chair for her to sit on. He then brought a cup of tea to quench her thirst and served her very attentively.
Zong Xueying drank the tea in the cup in one breath and let out a comfortable breath. "Ah...it tastes so good. I will come to the king for tea every day from now on."
She looked at him with a smile. Although he had a bad temper and always looked mean to her, she didn't hate him at all. She felt that he was more cautious than the palace officials who always acted cautiously.It's much easier to be real and understand, and she will never hide her true side, so she likes to come to argue with him, regardless of whether he is the king or not.
He was very busy, and although he sent people to take care of her, he rarely showed up on his own initiative, so she simply came to him by herself. Even if she could only see him for a moment, she would be very happy.
"You just want to come here and cause mischief every day!" Lan Ting glared at the little girl condescendingly. If the other palace maids and eunuchs had seen his disgusting face, they would have been trembling with fear, but she was the only one who didn't take it seriously at all. "I don't think about your current physical condition and how long you can endure it. Sooner or later you will not be able to bear it anymore."
